answer: The best sybil defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times consecutive honest epochs, so reputation grows like a glacier, not a burst. A fresh identity at any inlet to the economy starts near zero and cannot buy or transfer reputation, since history must accrue under one continuously honest operator. Mass-spawning accounts buys little power, and keeping each honest for months before it matters costs enormous time and stake, while one dishonest epoch resets accumulated weight, defeating the attack thread by thread.
